search.heading: What are you looking for?
search.noResultsBody: Try a shorter word, check the spelling, or open one of the aisles below.
search.startSubtitle: Search understands the name you use — “doodh”, “atta” and “sabzi” all work.
search.dealBody: See everything the shop has reduced today.

product.signInToSave: Sign in to save your favourites

hero.title: Your everyday groceries, without the hassle.
hero.scanCardBody: Photograph it, we fill the basket.

aisles.title: What are you shopping for?
aisles.subtitle: Fresh produce, pantry staples and daily essentials
aisles.errorTitle: We could not load the aisles
aisles.emptyTitle: The shop is still being set up
aisles.emptyBody: Aisles will appear here as soon as the store adds them.

reduced.title: Today's savings
reduced.subtitle: Everything here costs less than it did

picked.title: Picked out for you
picked.subtitle: What the shop wants you to see this week

arrivals.title: New on the shelves
arrivals.subtitle: The most recent additions to the shop

offer.body: Stock up while the price is down — the saving is shown on every one.

scan.title: Have a grocery list? Take a photo of it.
scan.body: Send us the list on the back of your envelope and we will find every item in the shop and put it in your basket. You check it before anything is ordered.
scan.step1Detail: Handwritten or printed. English or Urdu.
scan.step2Detail: Line by line, the way you wrote it.
scan.step3Detail: Matched against what the shop has today.
scan.step4Detail: Nothing is added without your say.

service.title: Two ways to get your groceries
service.subtitle: Whichever you choose, you see the full cost before you place the order.
service.deliveredBody: The charge is worked out from the road distance between the shop and your address, and shown to you before you place the order — never added afterwards.
service.collectBodyStore: Pack it up and pick it up from {store}, {area}. No delivery charge at all.
service.collectBodyGeneric: Pick your order up from the shop yourself. No delivery charge at all.
service.payBody: Pay the rider when your order reaches you, or pay at the counter when you collect it. Nothing is taken up front.

categories.title: Every aisle, end to end
categories.intro: Browse by aisle, or open one to filter by type, price and brand.
categories.noneBody: The shop has not published any categories. Please check back soon.
categories.missingTitle: We could not find that aisle
categories.missingBody: It may have been renamed, or the shop may no longer stock it.
categories.noMatchBody: There is nothing in {name} with those options. Try clearing one.

catalog.narrowDown: Narrow down what you are looking for

productPage.notFoundTitle: We could not find that product
productPage.notFoundBody: It may have been renamed, or the shop may no longer stock it.
productPage.deliveryNote: Delivery charge worked out from your address at checkout
productPage.collectNote: Or collect from the shop at no extra charge

favorites.signInTitle: Sign in to see your saved items
favorites.signInBody: Tap the heart on any product to keep it here for next time.
favorites.title: Saved items
favorites.subtitle: Everything you tapped the heart on, ready to add to your basket.
favorites.emptyBody: Tap the heart on any product and it will wait for you here.

cart.title: Your basket
cart.signInTitle: Sign in to see your basket
cart.signInBody: Your basket is saved to your account, so it is waiting for you on any device.
cart.emptyBody: Add a few everyday essentials and we will take it from there.
cart.issueUnavailable: No longer available. Remove it to continue.
cart.issueOutOfStock: Out of stock right now. Remove it or try again later.
cart.issueReduced: Not enough left in stock — lower the quantity to continue.
cart.needsAttention: Some items need your attention before you can check out.
cart.addSomething: Add something to your basket to continue.
cart.fixItems: Fix the items above to continue.
cart.seeCharge: You will see the delivery charge and your total before the order is placed.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in with the mobile number you shop with.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: It takes a minute. You only need a mobile number.
register.mobileHint: We use this to confirm your orders.
register.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters with a letter and a number.

addresses.title: Your addresses
addresses.signInTitle: Sign in to manage your addresses
addresses.signInBody: Saved addresses make checkout a couple of taps.
addresses.emptyBody: Add one now and checkout becomes a couple of taps. A landmark helps the rider find you.
addresses.noMapLocation: No map location — delivery to this address cannot be calculated. Edit it to add one.
addresses.locationNote: The map location is what lets us calculate your delivery charge.
addresses.removeBody: {address} will be removed from your address book. Past orders keep their own copy and are not affected.

form.kindQuestion: What kind of address is this?
form.mobileHint: The rider will call this number.
form.landmarkHint: Optional, but it is often how a rider actually finds the door.
form.instructionsHint: Optional. For example: ring the bell twice, gate code 1234.
form.mapBody: We use this to work out the distance and your delivery charge. Without it you can still save the address and collect your order from the store.
form.noGeolocation: This browser cannot share your location. Please enter it below.
form.tooVague: We could only place you within about {metres} m. Move outdoors and try again, or enter the location below.
form.permissionDenied: Location access was blocked. You can enter the coordinates below instead.
form.locationFailed: We could not find your location. Please enter it below.
form.canCalculate: Delivery to this address can be calculated.
form.makeDefaultCheckbox: Use this as my default delivery address

picker.question: Where should we deliver this order?
picker.noMapReason: This address has no map location, so we cannot work out a delivery charge. Edit it to add one.
picker.addBody: We will use this to calculate your delivery charge.
picker.emptyBody: Add where you would like this order delivered.
